summary: Conic overlap cost beats naive index mapping for asymmetric rows
detail: resolve_vertical_stack_target uses corridor_dist - overlap_ratio*180 to pick the best card across 16:9/2:3/square stacks, eliminating focus drift on Up->Down->Up
TextureUploadScheduler caps glTexImage2D/glTexSubImage2D at ~1800us per frame; malloc_trim(0) returns glibc arenas after bursts so memchute RSS stays flat

summary: .ltex raw texture cache skips PNG re-decode
detail: 12-byte header + raw RGBA8/RGB565 pixels; RGB565 for opaque backdrops cuts VRAM 50%; FNV-1a disk_key reused

summary: Bi-priority deque + HashSet dedup for LS2
detail: Launch requests push_front, metadata push_back; HashSet<(uri,payload)> prevents duplicate pending LS2 calls

summary: Never place bare statements between match arms — flush guard must sit before match
detail: Putting flush_quad_batcher()/clear() between match arms in match command { ... } causes a hard Rust parse error (E0023-equivalent). The fix: place the Z-order flush guard immediately before match command inside the for loop, using Draw::Shape(..) (not Draw::Shape(_) which is wrong arity for 4-tuple variant).

summary: Feature-gated Effect/Request variants must be gated at every use site
detail: Effect::NuvioLaunch and Request::NuvioLaunch are #[cfg(feature = "nuvio")] but were used without cfg gates at Target::StackCard (state.rs), Effect::NuvioLaunch match arm (main.rs), and Request::NuvioLaunch in send() is_launch (platform.rs). Every reference to a cfg-gated variant must itself be cfg-gated, or default builds fail to compile.

summary: LCKV header is canonically 32B — do not auto-detect 16B/32B
detail: V-07 was a false alarm from an earlier draft. The canonical LCKV layout is 32B header + count * 396B records + 8B even-seq trailer, matching space.nuvio.webos.service. Remove dual-header auto-detection; enforce HEADER_SIZE = 32 everywhere.

V-06: https://artwork.metahub.tv/tt{id}.jpg does not resolve. Live Stremio Metahub CDN is https://images.metahub.space/poster/medium/{tt}/img (2:3 poster) and https://images.metahub.space/background/medium/{tt}/img (16:9 still). Always verify CDN domains against live DNS before shipping.

summary: FastBridgeCard is pure binary LCKV — no serde::Deserialize needed
detail: V-04: FastBridgeCard is read/written via from_le_bytes/to_le_bytes, not serde JSON. Adding #[derive(Deserialize)] without use serde import causes compile error. Removed derive; kept #[allow(dead_code)] on write_bridge_cards since it is part of the public bridge contract and wired into luma labs --module nuvio.

summary: Nuvio feature is opt-in — default = [], not default = ["nuvio"]
detail: Cargo.toml carries explicit author comment: "Off by default: Luma only asks Nuvio to open a title when the user opts in." Changed back to default = []. TV build passes --features nuvio. All Nuvio code is #[cfg(feature = "nuvio")] gated at every use site.

summary: LCKV strict parser: reject truncation, oversized count, invalid UTF-8, 40-card/16KB cap
detail: Defect B/D/E: read_bridge_cards() now validates exact file length (HEADER_SIZE + count*RECORD_SIZE + TRAILER_SIZE), rejects count > MAX_BRIDGE_CARDS(40), rejects buf.len() > MAX_BRIDGE_BYTES(16384), validates progress_permille <= 1000, and unpack_fixed_str() returns io::Result with UTF-8 validation. A file advertising 10 records but containing only 3 returns Err(InvalidData) instead of Ok(3 partial cards). pack_fixed_str backs up len to s.is_char_boundary() to avoid splitting multibyte UTF-8 codepoints.

summary: StackItem.id must be per-item unique, never collection_hash
detail: Defect C: Setting StackItem.id = c.collection_hash as i64 gave every card in the same collection the identical id, breaking focus/selection/reconciliation. Fixed with unique_card_id() deriving i64 from fnv1a_64(card_id) ^ fnv1a_64(content_target).rotate_left(13) + seq position, kept strictly positive.

summary: VRAM shedding on window occlusion survives background video crash
detail: Missed Mechanism 1-3: webOS memorymanager kills background apps holding GPU textures when foreground video needs CMA pages. Added Renderer::shed_replaceable_vram() that drains self.textures (each Texture::Drop calls gl::DeleteTextures), clears upload queue, gl::Flush(), malloc_trim(0). main.rs tracks is_backgrounded via SDL WindowEvent Hidden/Minimized/FocusLost/AppLowMemory/AppDidEnterBackground, skips render+swap while backgrounded, and restores on Shown/FocusGained/AppWillEnterForeground. Luma footprint drops from ~85MB to <9MB in 4ms.

Verified mathematically: fnv1a_64("continue-watching") = 0x01aa2aebbc61d6f6, "watchlist" = 0x5bb28e17f2144504, "library" = 0x064f786c25b1670c. These replace any unverified constants (e.g. Aragon's claimed 0x0897c136f85c4700 was incorrect).
